description: This Java class 'FlexibleMessage' wraps messages that can be either static strings or retrieved from properties files, supporting dynamic message expansion based on environment variables.

classes.name: FlexibleMessage
classes.description: A class that manages message retrieval and formatting, supporting static strings and property-based messages with optional expression expansion.

methods.name: FlexibleMessage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message based on an XML element and default property.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message string, expanding expressions if necessary, using the provided class loader and method context.
